title: Nested open single direct-image comparison
statement: Let $f:X\to S$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme], $F$ an $\mathcal O_X$-module, $U\subset S$ open and $V\subset U$ open. Put $j=V.\iota\circ U.\iota:V\to S$, $Z=X\times_S V$, $a:Z\to X$ and $r:Z\to V$ [def-pc-fibre-product]. Use the supplied derived localizations on $X,S,U$ and the localized module site over $V$ [def-pc-derived-category]. Let $D_Z,D_V$ be the standard localizations and $E$ the inverse exact localized-site equivalence for $V$ [def-pc-derived-open-restriction-maps]. Then $\operatorname{over}_V((Rf_*F[0])|_U)\cong E_D(Rr_*(a^*F)[0])$, where $a^*$ is ordinary tensor pullback [def-pc-module-pullback], $E_D$ is the induced exact derived functor, and the direct images are [def-pc-derived-direct-image]. No quasi-compactness, separatedness, flatness or quasi-coherence is imposed.

proof.text: Compose overFunctorEquiv for U and V with restrictFunctorComp. Cancel the forward equivalence using its unit to identify the composite localized restriction R with restriction along j = V.ι ≫ U.ι followed by the inverse overEquiv V.

Reuse the proved private Scheme.Modules.pushforward_restrict_square from DirectImage.Sections by proof-only import all on the canonical pullback square. Whisker by the inverse over equivalence and reassociate, giving f_* ⋙ R ≅ restrict(a) ⋙ (r_* ⋙ E).

Use exactness and K-injective preservation of restriction along a. Derive the underived natural isomorphism with rightDerivedFunctorNatIso; compose rightDerivedFunctorCompMapDerivedCategoryIso, rightDerivedFunctorCompIso and rightDerivedFunctorIsoMapDerivedCategory, keeping independent localization universes.

Uniqueness of left adjoints identifies ordinary restriction along a with tensorPullback a. Evaluate the derived functor comparison on F[0], use mapDerivedCategorySingleFunctor, and map the coefficient isomorphism through Rr_* and the inverse over equivalence. mapDerivedCategoryCompIso identifies the left-hand two restrictions.

theorem nestedOpen_single_directImage_comparison
    {X S : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S)
    [HasDerivedCategory.{wX}
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{wS}
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings S.toRingedSpace))]
    (F : X.Modules) (U : S.Opens)
    [HasDerivedCategory.{wS}
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings U.toScheme.toRingedSpace))]
    (V : U.toScheme.Opens)
    [HasDerivedCategory.{wS}
      (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings U.toScheme.toRingedSpace).over V))] :
  let dV := HasDerivedCategory.standard
    (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings V.toScheme.toRingedSpace))
  letI := dV
  letI := HasDerivedCategory.standard (SheafOfModules.{u}
    (moduleRings (pullback f (V.ι ≫ U.ι)).toRingedSpace))
  Nonempty ((SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{u}
      (moduleRings U.toScheme.toRingedSpace) V).mapDerivedCategory.obj
      ((schemeOpenRestriction S U).mapDerivedCategory.obj
        ((schemeDerivedDirectImage f).obj ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
          (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) 0).obj F))) ≅
    (@Functor.mapDerivedCategory _ _ _ dV _ _ _ _
      (Scheme.Modules.overEquiv V).inverse _ _ _).obj
      ((schemeDerivedDirectImage (pullback.snd f (V.ι ≫ U.ι))).obj
        ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (SheafOfModules.{u}
          (moduleRings (pullback f (V.ι ≫ U.ι)).toRingedSpace)) 0).obj
          (Scheme.Modules.tensorPullbackObj (pullback.fst f (V.ι ≫ U.ι)) F))))
